name: cumora
description: Run Cumora agents on your own machine with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and other BYOA engines.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.accessSync('dist/cli.js');const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/build-info.json'));const p=require('./package.json');if(b.packageVersion!==p.version||b.version!==p.version+'+'+b.commit||!b.release||!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(b.commit))throw Error('Build the matching fork Release before pack')"
